title: redteam neyman
summary: A security team has 120 red-team test runs to estimate an overall issue rate across three components. The components contain 1000, 400, and 100 equally weighted scenarios respectively. Pilot data give within-component standard deviations of issue indicators 1, 3, and 6 on a common scale. Runs have equal cost. The team must allocate integer runs across components to minimize the variance of the stratified overall estimator, rather than merely sampling in proportion to component size.
